conclusion: Beam=4 S1 constrained decoding on full 998-doc DocRED with ZS Llama-3.1-8B eliminates all DR violations (2.55% → 0%), reduces CF violations (8.54% → 1.00%), and improves both E-F1 (+2.88) and R-F1 (+2.56) vs ZS greedy baseline. Confirms constraint effectiveness generalizes across full dataset and second model (Llama).
note: d064/d065 Llama DocRED results (E-F1~85, R-F1~45) are from a different experiment campaign and likely used FT models, not directly comparable to this ZS run.
